testcases.name: wan22-ti2v-5b-l0
testcases.description: Wan2.2 TI2V-5B reduced-profile native video generation contract
testcases.test_prompt: Two anthropomorphic cats in comfy boxing gear and bright gloves fight intensely on a spotlighted stage
testcases.notes: Premerge L0 builds the source-bound bundle and runs the public Python-free native video path at 672x384, five frames, fifteen UniPC steps, CFG 5, flow shift 5, 24 FPS, seed 42, and the fixed 512-token UMT5 profile. The L4 gate verifies exact output shape and non-degenerate pixels; accuracy promotion still requires the separate source-bound official-Wan comparison.
